description: 6_n1ql.md correctly documents that 'CREATE INDEX' names two different, differently-typed statements depending on dialect (Query service vs. Analytics). primer-beer.md's own worked tutorial then demonstrates the collision in practice rather than just describing it: its index-creation example is written in the short form (`CREATE INDEX callsignidx ON airline (callsign: STRING);`), not the long `CREATE ANALYTICS INDEX` form 5_ddl.md's own DDL reference uses. A reader who has only seen this tutorial, with no exposure to 5_ddl.md's terminology, has no way to know they are not writing a Query-service GSI statement - the short spelling is the tutorial's only spelling of it.
